You don’t need to be fit to start. You just need to show up.

Welcome to the grind. Welcome to One Life.

membership_templates.name: Engine Course
membership_templates.description:
Don't you hate that feeling when you get on the rower, start rowing, look up and only see 5 calories and you are already out of breath? Yeah, me too, it sucks! 
Rowing is hard but it's even worse when you are not proficient at rowing. It may feel like you are rowing upstream and not getting anywhere! 

​​​​​​​Well I'm excited to let you know I have a lot of the answers how to make rowing feel easier and it all starts with a couple things. 

Technique, breathing patterns, aerobic capacity! 2 of those things I can teach you, the other one you need to put the work in to improve! 

Starting Wednesday, October 16th 2024 at 6:30pm, Hans will be hosting an Engine Course! the course will be 6 weeks long, meeting every Wednesday @6:30pm

membership_templates.name: 🔥'25 Summer Shred Challenge: Train Hard, Eat Smart, Get Ripped🔥
membership_templates.description:
Summer is coming fast, and this is your chance to get lean, get strong, and reveal the muscle you’ve been working for! The 2025 Summer Shred Challenge at OneLife CrossFit is a 6-week guided fat-burning program designed to help you lose fat, maintain muscle, and stay accountable with expert coaching and a competitive edge.

This isn’t just a challenge—it’s your roadmap to serious results. Each week, we’ll give you a specific focus to lock in on, and you’ll earn points by staying consistent and committed.

🔥 How It Works

📆 6 Weeks of Fat-Burning Focus

📅 Start Date: April 6, 2025
📅 End Date: May 18, 2025

Every day, you’ll earn points by sticking to the weekly focus and completing healthy habits.

💥 Why Join?
✅ You’ll Have a Plan – Each week gives you a clear goal to focus on.
✅ You’ll Stay Accountable – Earn points by showing up and staying consistent.
✅ You’ll Get Expert Guidance – We’ll tell you what to focus on for fat loss and muscle retention.
✅ You’ll Push Yourself – Compete with other members and stay motivated.
✅ You’ll Be Summer-Ready – Because this is YOUR year to get shredded.

💰 Exclusive Discounts for Participants
While enrolled in the Summer Shred Challenge, participants will receive 15% off on Private Training and Nutrition Coaching to maximize their results.

🔥 The Weekly Focus Habits:
Week 1: No processed carbs (flour, sugar, packaged junk)
Week 2: Hit 1.2g of protein per pound of your desired body weight
Week 3: Get 8 hours in bed (because recovery = results!)
Week 4: No processed carbs (flour, sugar, packaged junk) – round 2!
Week 5: Eat 30g of fiber per day
Week 6: Intermittent fasting – 6-hour eating window

Read more at https://onelifecrossfit.com/announcements/f/%F0%9F%94%A525-summer-shred-challenge-train-hard-eat-smart-get-ripped%F0%9F%94%A5

data.name: Private Training
data.description:
Why invest in personal training?
Personalized instruction means that every second of your gym time is devoted to meeting your needs. As a busy adult, finding time to prioritize exercise can often feel like an impossible task. However, Personal Training offers a solution tailored to your hectic schedule. Our flexible training options allow you to work out on your own time, with sessions conveniently scheduled around your commitments.

With 100% attention on you, your Personal Trainer can help you build a specific skill set, strengthen weak areas, gain a competitive edge in your sport, and stay motivated to reach your goals.

data.name: Online Consultation
data.description:
Book a session to tell us your goals and we will put together a plan on how to meet them. 

Our mission at One Life CrossFit is to coach greatness into your life. Fitness, accountability, and direction are the tools we use to attain your goals.

The meeting will be over video call. Your provided phone number will be used as a backup method. If you would like an in-person meeting please reach out to team@onelifecrossfit.com.
